$comment: The source of sf-tooltip's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/tooltip (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

x-summary: Tooltip surface that can join the ordinary data-tooltip trigger composition.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-tooltip for a short non-interactive description. Link it to a native trigger with the ordinary data-tooltip composition when Framework should own hover, focus and Escape behavior.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not place links, buttons or fields inside a tooltip
Do not use aria-expanded or aria-haspopup for tooltip visibility

x-renamed: settings.type → appearance: the axis's old name (contracts/public-api-axes.json), alias dated
x-decisions: a11y-role: tooltip, one role; the name is the text (the setting, or the text slot). The data-tooltip controller of the class component links a trigger to it with aria-describedby.
a11y-name: from text, then slot:text (the old shape "internal" said the same).

layer: none. sf-tooltip is the tooltip's look, drawn where it stands; it neither opens nor closes and takes no keys. The tooltip that floats over the page is the class controller's ([data-tooltip], component/tooltip/js/_tooltip.js), a layer for its own migration.
version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: type is a dated alias of appearance.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; the slots content, text, supporting-text and tail are the page's nodes, placed.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus the dark look, an arrow and supporting text; probe.json reads the drawn markup.
css-variables: the eight public variables the sheet already reads (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).
